==Biography==
Inspired was born in Białystok, Poland. He began playing ''League of Legends'' in Season 3.

== Trivia ==
* He is known for achieving Top 50 in Challenger at 15 years old.
* First LEC player born in 2002 (second youngest player to attend LEC as of [[LEC/2019 Season/Summer Season|LEC 2019 Summer]] is [[Jeskla]] born August 2000).
* First LEC jungler to get a pentakill in a LEC match.
* First Polish player to play in the LCS.
* Only player to be LEC MVP ([[LEC/2021 Season/Summer Season|2021 Summer]]) and LEC Rookie of the Split ([[LEC/2019 Season/Summer Season|2019 Summer]])
* Only player to be LEC MVP ([[LEC/2021 Season/Summer Season|2021 Summer]]) and LCS MVP ([[LCS/2022 Season/Summer Season|2022 Summer]])
* Only player to be LTA MVP ([[LTA North/2025 Season/Split 2|2025 Split 2]]) and LCS MVP ([[LCS/2022 Season/Summer Season|2022 Summer]])
* Third player to do a Pentakill in both EU LCS/LEC and NA LCS/LTA after [[Bjergsen]] and [[Zven]], if we consider EU and NA in general he's fourth behind [[UNF0RGIVEN]]

=== Individual Awards ===
* x1 LTA Player of the Year ([[LTA North/2025 Season/Split 3|2025 Split 3]])
* x2 League Awards LCS/LTA Player of the Year ([[League Awards 2024|2024]], [[League Awards 2025|2025]])
* x2 LCS/LTA North Most Valuable Player ([[LCS/2022 Season/Summer Season|2022 Summer]], [[LTA North/2025 Season/Split 2|2025 Split 2]])
* x1 LCS Finals MVP ([[LCS/2024 Season/Championship|2024 Summer]])
* x3 LCS/LTA North 1st All-Pro Team ([[LCS/2022 Season/Summer Season|2022 Summer]], [[LTA North/2025 Season/Split 2|2025 Split 2]], [[LTA North/2025 Season/Split 3|2025 Split 3]])
* x2 LCS 2nd All-Pro Team ([[LCS/2024 Season/Spring Season|2024 Spring]], [[LCS/2024 Season/Summer Season|2024 Summer]])
* x1 LCS 3rd All-Pro Team ([[LCS/2023 Season/Spring Season|2023 Spring]])
* x1 LEC Most Valuable Player ([[LEC/2021 Season/Summer Season|2021 Summer]])
* x1 LEC 1st All-Pro Team ([[LEC/2021 Season/Summer Season|2021 Summer]])
* x2 LEC 2nd All-Pro Team ([[LEC/2020 Season/Summer Season|2020 Summer]], [[LEC/2021 Season/Spring Season|2021 Spring]])
* LEC Rookie of the Split ([[LEC/2019 Season/Summer Season|2019 Summer]])
